title: Rosie O’Donnell Rags on Trump’s Strait of Hormuz Claims
summary: “I’ll put it this way: If the U.S. is in charge of the strait, then I’m also straight — and let’s face it, I’m not,” the guest host said on “Jimmy Kimmel Live.”
